verdict.rationale: Nitrokey documents FIDO2/PIV/OpenPGP protocol support and a specific 'Nitrokey Provisioning for Entra ID' tool, showing some IdP integration, but there is no evidence of Okta or Google Workspace integration, nor any admin console/policy engine to enforce hardware-key-only authentication fleet-wide. Missing for 10: Okta integration, Google Workspace integration, centralized policy enforcement/fleet management console, documentation of admin-side enrollment/compliance workflows.
